WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT m.department, COUNT(*) AS income_count
    FROM income AS i
    JOIN member AS mb ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id
    JOIN major AS m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
    GROUP BY m.department
), department_shares AS (
    SELECT department, income_count,
           1.0 * income_count / SUM(income_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM department_counts
), scored AS (
    SELECT department, income_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM department_shares
)
SELECT SUM(income_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - average_share)
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share
